title: The finite tensor comparison in its ordinary representative coordinates
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, n ≥ 0, and f:X→Y, with l invertible on X,Y. Let O_f be the existing identified-coefficient module pullback and U_f its termwise functor. Let r_W(P,Q) be the existing flat K-flat tensor representative comparison followed by pullbackTensorFiniteModelIso. Let e_f:Q F_f≅U_f Q be the inverse derived finite realization followed by the ordinary exact-pullback factors, and b_f(P,Q) the inverse of proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso. For every flat K-flat pair P,Q, the ordinary pullbacks are flat K-flat and F_f(r_Y) μ_f T_X(e_f(P),e_f(Q)) = e_f(Tot(P⊗Q)) Q(b_f(P,Q)) r_X(U_f P,U_f Q), in traversal order. The module exports only compositions and specializations of the existing comparison maps; moduleComp is the conjugation of sfIntrinsicPullbackComp by the three prescribed finite realizations, and complexComp is its termwise lift.

proof.text: Apply the chosen representative characterization in proEtaleCanonicalTensorPullback with the two restricted finite tensor models. This supplies the flat-term K-flat preservation witnesses and its normalized square.

Compose the two tensor-model representatives with their fixed identifications, and use the inverse derived realization to express exact pullback in ordinary coordinates. Naturality moves the realization through the source representative, and moves the target model identification through the computation maps. Functoriality cancels the realization and its inverse in each tensor factor; the remaining equation is the supplied normalized square. This is the proved transport_square calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem square {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (P Q : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ)
    (hP : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P)
    (hQ : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) Q) :
    ∃ (hP' : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
        ((pull l E f n).obj P))
      (hQ' : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
        ((pull l E f n).obj Q)),
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map (representative l E Y n P Q hP hQ).hom ≫
        ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY)
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)).hom ≫
        (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map
          (Prod.mkHom ((factors l E f n).hom.app P) ((factors l E f n).hom.app Q)) =
      (factors l E f n).hom.app (tensor l E Y n P Q) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (comparison l E f n P Q) ≫
        (representative l E X n _ _ hP' hQ').hom
